package.name: soslab_gl5_driver
package.description: SOSLAB GL-5 lidar driver, packaged as a PREBUILT aarch64 binary. 2026-08-05: binary REBUILT from the official SOSLAB_SDK (github.com/SOSLAB-github/SOSLAB_SDK, cloned at ~/SOSLAB_SDK) — node source is in src/gl5_node.cpp (no longer lost!). Publishes x,y,z,intensity (raw pulse width) instead of the old x,y,z,rgb colormap. The last known-good LOST-SOURCE binary is backed up as a git repo at ~/backups/soslab_gl5_driver_prebuilt_backup (and in this repo's history). RUNPATH $ORIGIN so libLidar_x64_release.so ships alongside. Publishes /soslab/pointcloud (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2, frame from param).
